Handmade things, made slowly, by real people.

Terra & Thread is a marketplace for pottery, weaving and woodwork from 48 independent makers. Every piece is one of a kind, and 80% of each sale goes straight to the maker.

New from the studios

Small batches, so when it's gone, it's gone.

Meet the makers

Every maker is visited by our team before they join, so you always know who made your piece.

Ines Duarte

Potter · Porto, Portugal

Wheel-thrown stoneware in soft, glossy glazes, fired in a wood kiln she built herself.

Kofi Mensah

Weaver · Kumasi, Ghana

Hand-loomed cotton throws and cushions using patterns passed down through four generations.

Elin Berg

Woodworker · Bergen, Norway

Serving boards and spoons carved from fallen birch and oak, finished with food-safe oil.

How made to order works

You order

Choose a piece and any size or colour options.

The maker makes

Your piece is made by hand in 1 to 3 weeks.

We check

Every item is checked and wrapped in recycled paper.

It arrives

Delivered with a card signed by the maker.

Give a gift card

Let them choose something handmade. Sent by email with your message, and valid for two years.

Questions

Is every piece really handmade?

Yes. Every item is made by hand by the maker named on the page. No mass production and no factories.

Why does my piece look a little different from the photo?

Because it's handmade, each piece has small differences in glaze, colour and texture. That's what makes it one of a kind.

Can I become a maker?

We welcome applications from independent makers. Send us photos of your work and we'll arrange a studio visit.
